title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Benito Jones released by Raiders
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Noah Brown signs with Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders signed WR Noah Brown.
items.impact: Brown will hold a depth role in the wide receiver room for Las Vegas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adoree' Jackson linked to Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys have shown interest in CB Adoree' Jackson.
items.impact: Jackson was with DC Christian Parker in Philadelphia. He is reportedly drawing interest from multiple teams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Otis Reese IV re-signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills re-signed LB Otis Reese IV.
items.impact: Reese will compete for a depth role in the linebacker room for Buffalo.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chandler Martin signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed LB Chandler Martin.
items.impact: Martin will compete for a depth role in the Giants linebacker room.
